svg.aria-label: An animation inserting nine keys into a hash table using separate chaining
svg.text: Separate chaining: every slot is the head of a list

text.font-family: Cascadia Code, Fira Code, JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: h(22) = 22 mod 11 = 0. Slot 0 is empty, so 22 goes in.
